Finding_Description: Software engineering team pushed hardcoded AWS production secret keys and API credentials into public GitHub repository
Tailored_Remediation_Recommendation: Enforce automated Static Application Security Testing (SAST), pre-commit secret detection hooks, and mandatory peer code review before merge.

Finding_Description: Production PostgreSQL database snapshot backups have not undergone quarterly automated restoration and recovery testing
Tailored_Remediation_Recommendation: Enable automated cross-region database snapshot replication, enforce immutable Object Lock, and conduct bi-annual disaster recovery restore drills.

Finding_Description: Single sign-on enforcement audit revealed 14 contractor accounts lack mandatory hardware security key multi-factor authentication
Tailored_Remediation_Recommendation: Enforce phishing-resistant FIDO2/WebAuthn multi-factor authentication (MFA) across all administrative consoles and single-sign-on (SSO) portals.

Finding_Description: Customer personally identifiable data stored in cold S3 archiving buckets is unencrypted at rest without KMS key rotation
Tailored_Remediation_Recommendation: Enforce TLS 1.3 in transit, migrate to AWS KMS AES-256 customer-managed keys (CMK) at rest, and implement automated 365-day key rotation.

Finding_Description: Production Kubernetes ingress firewall allows unrestricted external 0.0.0.0/0 traffic to internal Redis cache cluster
Tailored_Remediation_Recommendation: Restrict security groups removing 0.0.0.0/0 ingress on ports 22/5432, enable VPC flow logs, and deploy Web Application Firewall (WAF) rate limits.

Finding_Description: Third-party payroll SaaS vendor SOC 2 Type II attestation report expired 8 months ago without renewed security assessment
Tailored_Remediation_Recommendation: Collect annual SOC 2 Type II / ISO 27001 reports, execute third-party risk assessments, and mandate signed Data Processing Addenda (DPA).

Finding_Description: Quarterly vulnerability scanning identified 12 unpatched critical kernel CVEs on external-facing customer API gateways
Tailored_Remediation_Recommendation: Configure automated CI/CD container vulnerability scanning (Trivy), establish 14-day SLA for Critical CVEs, and track patch status in Jira.

Finding_Description: Application central audit logs lack automated real-time SIEM alerting for anomalous administrative privilege escalation events
Tailored_Remediation_Recommendation: Enforce quarterly user access reviews (UAR), automate SCIM deprovisioning from HRIS, and implement least-privilege role boundaries.

Finding_Description: Physical access badges to server room and network wiring closet were not revoked for 3 employees terminated last month
Tailored_Remediation_Recommendation: Restrict security groups removing 0.0.0.0/0 ingress on ports 22/5432, enable VPC flow logs, and deploy Web Application Firewall (WAF) rate limits.

Finding_Description: Code merge pipeline allowed developer pull request to merge into main branch without mandatory second-engineer peer review
Tailored_Remediation_Recommendation: Enforce automated Static Application Security Testing (SAST), pre-commit secret detection hooks, and mandatory peer code review before merge.
